name: Lubair Aviation Technology
summary: Lubair Aviation Technology Co., Ltd. is a global provider of comprehensive material solutions for the aviation sector. Its extensive product portfolio spans specialized aviation materials, ranging from various oils, chemicals, and raw materials to a wide array of components, safety equipment, tools, adhesives, and ground support consumables. The company supplies everything from lubricating oils, seat belts, and standard parts to deicing fluids, electrical components, structural materials, and various interior and exterior aircraft necessities. In addition to offering products under its own brands—LuHope, SANI MER, Dr.C.C., and AeroComm—Lubair also distributes offerings from leading international manufacturers such as ExxonMobil, 3M, Av-DEC, EC, Lufthansa Technology, Huntsman, Lanxess, and Bosch. Its diverse clientele includes airlines, aircraft maintenance organizations, aircraft manufacturers, and original equipment manufacturers (OEMs). Established in 2005, Lubair Aviation Technology maintains its headquarters in Shenzhen, China.
